Sources: NSF award records FY2022–26, joined to institutions by UEI and a hand-checked crosswalk. Dollars are each award's full intended value in the fiscal year it was made, not the amount paid out so far; that keeps years comparable, since continuing grants are paid in annual increments, but it counts money that could still be cut. FY2026 is a partial year (data pulled Sept 19, 2026). Peers and filtered sets are drawn from the full Carnegie universe of 3,282 degree-granting institutions whether or not they hold NSF awards; private for-profits are excluded. Institutional factors: 2025 Carnegie Classifications, IPEDS, NSF HERD. R&D bands use each institution's exact total R&D from HERD (FY2024, or FY2023 if that's its latest report); campuses HERD reports together use Carnegie's FY2023 campus figure. An institution showing $0 may hold small awards not yet resolved in the crosswalk. Prototype.
